card.name: Space before a small decimal volume
card.fires_on: The space or joining word just before a number, often a decimal like 0.5 or 0.1, that is about to be given as a volume or amount (mL). It appears in dose-drawing and measurement instructions.

modes.label: Space before volume
modes.description: The space token right before a decimal volume in mL in draw-up or fill instructions.
modes.example: To administer a 10 mg dose, draw up<< >>0.5 mL of the reconst

modes.label: Rounding or ratio words
modes.description: A word or slash just before a decimal volume, such as nearest or a mg/mL ratio.

modes.label: Limit before number
modes.description: The space after phrases like up to or no more than, just before a small number.
modes.example: A total of no more than<< >>1 mL at weekly intervals is recommended.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output a digit 0 next, as in a leading zero of a decimal, and away from punctuation.
card.plain: It fires right before a small decimal amount like 0.5 mL is written in dosing instructions.
